acceptance: The site-inputs bundle carries the benchmark card data, produced from core metadata
landing-data.ts card content is generated at build time; the hand-kept literal is gone
Changing a benchmark's query count in core changes the landing card after the next bundle
context: Found 2026-10-17 at site-split closeout (follow-up list in site-split-99). A bundle schema addition is additive (ADR D16: no schema bump); core lands first, site second.
description:
benchbox-site website/src/lib/landing-data.ts (655 lines) holds the landing page's benchmark cards (names, query and table counts, doc links) as a hand-maintained literal, used by website/src/pages/index.astro and website/src/components/landing/CatalogGroup.astro. Core owns those facts, so the cards drift whenever core adds a benchmark or changes a count, and nothing detects it.

Carry the card data in the site-inputs bundle (core scripts/site_inputs.py) and have the site build generate the cards from it, failing the build if the bundle lacks the data.
